name: PRUDENTIAL PLC
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

ads_ratio.source: Prudential plc Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended 31 December 2025 (accession 0001628280-26-021178, filed 2026-03-26), cover page: Title of 12(b) Security 'American Depositary Shares, each representing 2 Ordinary Shares, 5 pence par value each', trading symbol PUK, New York Stock Exchange (the ordinary shares themselves are registered separately as PUK/D, not traded as the priced security). Earlier citation (2026-10-14 worker): Prudential plc Form 20-F cover / registered security title for the NYSE listing: American Depositary Shares, each representing two ordinary shares of 5 pence each (EDGAR security title 'PRUDENTIAL PLC ADS (REP 2 ORD SHARES)'); the same 1 ADS = 2 ordinary shares ratio is stated in the filer's Form S-8/F-6 registrations
ads_ratio.reason: 20-F filer: EDGAR per-share figures are per ordinary share while the NYSE price is per ADS; per-share figures must be scaled x2 ordinary shares per ADS to be comparable to the ADS price. This also halves the engine's naive market-cap estimate (ordinary shares x ADS price). Ratio stated in the filer's own FY2025 Form 20-F cover page (accession 0001628280-26-021178): each ADS represents 2 ordinary shares.

fx_conversion.source: frankfurter.app — ECB reference rates (closest business day to each period end)

overrides_applied.source: Prudential plc Annual Report 2024 (financial statements incorporated in Form 20-F for FY2024), note B2.2(d) 'Sharebased payment expense charged to the income statement': total expense recognised in 2024 relating to sharebased compensation is $85 million (2023: $81 million), of which $76 million equity-settled. Prudential reports in US dollars.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc - SBC missing for FY2020-25 under every ifrs-full tag the engine reads (ExpenseFromSharebasedPaymentTransactionsWithEmployees was last filed for FY2019, $181M USD). The filer's own stated FY2024 expense fills the gap in principle; the engine applies a single value to every missing period and FY2023's value in the same note ($81M) is the same magnitude (~2-3% of OCF). NOTE (2026-10-14 worker): the engine did NOT apply this override - _override_usd requires a GBP ECB rate for each fill period because stray GBP facts through 2018 created fx_info, and rates_by_currency[GBP] covers only 2014-2018, so fills for 2020-25 return None and the gap stands. Engine/main-agent fix needed; see queue block reason. ENGINE 5.5 RE-SCORE (2026-10-19): the 2026-10-14 note above is superseded. Ruling 7: currency "USD" is added (the note is presented in US$ millions), and engine 5.5 uses the value verbatim (override_checks.sbc.currency_basis declared_usd) for every missing year, FY2020-25, so DATA_GAP:sbc is covered. The value is carried through unchanged at $85M (WORKER_SPEC step 8: an override already in judgment.json is a main-agent decision). For the record, the FY2025 Form 20-F (accession 0001628280-26-021178, filed 2026-03-26), note B2.2(d), states $95M for 2025 (2024: $85M; 2023: $81M); whether to restate the single value to $95M is left to Andrew. Correction to the text above: SBC is not ~2-3% of OCF in every year; $85M is about 10% of FY2023 OCF ($832M), 2.4% of FY2024 ($3,609M) and 3.5% of FY2025 ($2,450M).

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency GBP converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion
USD_TRANSLATIONS_USED: the issuer files its own USD convenience translations alongside its reporting currency; the engine used the filed USD figures

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x2.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Prudential plc Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended 31 December 2025 (accession 0001628280-26-021178, filed 2026-03-26), cover page: Title of 12(b) Security 'American Depositary Shares, each representing 2 Ordinary Shares, 5 pence par value each', trading symbol PUK, New York Stock Exchange (the ordinary shares themselves are registered separately as PUK/D, not traded as the priced security). Earlier citation (2026-10-14 worker): Prudential plc Form 20-F cover / registered security title for the NYSE listing: American Depositary Shares, each representing two ordinary shares of 5 pence each (EDGAR security title 'PRUDENTIAL PLC ADS (REP 2 ORD SHARES)'); the same 1 ADS = 2 ordinary shares ratio is stated in the filer's Form S-8/F-6 registrations) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already

DEBT_TAGS_BLANK: no debt tag reports for the latest fiscal year — net debt is UNKNOWN (not zero); no leverage verdict is possible from the engine, state the balance sheet from the filing in analysis.md

CAPEX_COVERAGE_LOW: capex is below 50% of D&A in each of the last 3 fiscal years (FY2023 8%, FY2024 19%, FY2025 18%) at a filer with positive PP&E — reconcile total capex against the cash-flow statement's investing section (construction in progress, capitalised software, land-use rights, spectrum, intangible purchases) before trusting the owner's-earnings base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:sbc — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Prudential plc Annual Report 2024 (financial statements incorporated in Form 20-F for FY2024), note B2.2(d) 'Sharebased payment expense charged to the income statement': total expense recognised in 2024 relating to sharebased compensation is $85 million (2023: $81 million), of which $76 million equity-settled. Prudential reports in US dollars.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (9.9%) vs bull-case tier B (15.9%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base or a --base-judgment payable base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output / make_score's payable_5y impact
